Package com.sandy.sconsole.ai

Record Class HubStatus.ModelStatus

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.sandy.sconsole.ai.HubStatus.ModelStatus
Record Components:
id - the model id
gateway - its gateway's name
displayName - its display name, else its id
usable - it can be sent requests at all
available - usable and not held back right now
heldUntil - epoch ms its pause (after a rate limit on it) lifts; 0 if none
heldReason - why it is held back; null if it isn't
heldForTheDay - its own daily limit is reached
inFlight - its requests in flight
maxParallel - its slots
waiting - waiting jobs that may run on it now
avgLatencyMs - its average reply time over its last replies; 0 if it has none
succeeded - its attempts that succeeded since the start
failed - its attempts that failed (not handed back)
rpm - its own requests-per-minute limit (provider and app combined); 0 for none
rpd - its own requests-per-day limit; 0 for none
lastMinute - its requests started in the last 60 s
today - its requests today (UTC); only kept with an rpd
enabledGlobally - its switch in the global config
enabledInApp - its switch in the app config
passthrough - set to pass its jobs through (AIHub.setPassthrough(java.lang.String, boolean))
passthroughGuard - its fallback has a passthrough guard, so passing its jobs through has somewhere to send them
